answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to anchor in a lagoon of shared stakes and emit a canyon-deep pulse across a harbor of timed peer challenges each epoch. Verification samples five random harbor points%3B each extra fake forces the attacker to source fresh external entropy for those points%2C so one hundred clones cost roughly five hundred distinct oracle queries while an honest agent needs only three. The mechanism fails if the harbor itself is colluded.
